title: Design: at 200% zoom the Labor and Parts labels show in full
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" both set to that staff member.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "card-09-n1-added.png" (board 1.9) and "card-10-n1-added-hover.png" (board 1.10) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the work order in that browser window.
custom_steps:
1. Set the browser zoom to 200%.
  2. Hover over the Sales Representative rows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both labels show in full, never cut off, as in the picture of board 1.9.

Step 2:

  • Both labels still show in full.
  • No arrow covers a label.
  • Each arrow sits in the bottom-right corner of its field, on the name line, as in the picture of board 1.10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R14: “Both labels show in full on the card, never cut off.”
  • S1-R11: “The dropdown arrow sits at the right end of the field, vertically centered on the label and the name together, the same as on Lead Technician and Service Advisor. With the Labor and Parts fields showing (S2-R5), the arrow sits instead in the bottom-right corner of each field, on the name line, so it never covers the longer label on a narrow or zoomed screen.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.9 Parts added: both rows copy Becky; 1.10 Hover: two rows (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: card-09-n1-added.png, card-10-n1-added-hover.png.

  • Design — board 1.9 title: “1.9 Parts added: both rows copy Becky”
  • Design — board 1.9 note: “Two rows, "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both reading Becky Gonzales: the added row starts with the person the work order already credits (decision 65), so adding it alone moves no credit. No list opens on its own. Labels show in full. Measured gaps: 16px, 16px, 16px.”
  • Design — board 1.10 title: “1.10 Hover: two rows”
  • Design — board 1.10 note: “Both boxes show at once, each with its arrow. With Labor and Parts showing, the arrow sits on the name line in the bottom corner (decision 70). The + is gone (nothing left to add); the Parts row has a grey x beside it that removes the row.”
